seo.title_language: Hindi in ROMAN script (Hinglish), not Devanagari (Raj, 28 Oct 2026). Title = 1 emoji + a specific challenge/curiosity hook built from the real question (numbers, names) + title_suffix.
seo.tags_rule: base_tags (10) + 1 Hindi topic tag + 1 English topic tag = 12
seo.never_mix_classes: Class 6 and Class 9 are different exams. Never put both in one title/description/tag set.
seo.previous_papers_label: Never write PYQ / previous year paper. Use स्मृति-आधारित or पैटर्न-आधारित.
hook_frames: challenge: '... = ? 10 second mein!' / 'Kya aap sahi karoge?'
curiosity: 'X udta hai, phir bhi pakshi kyun nahin?'
mistake: '... Simplify karna mat bhoolna' / 'Sabse aasaan, phir bhi galti!'
exam: '28 Nov se pehle yeh pakka karo' (only while the exam date is ahead)
